evaluationType: Synthetic deterministic regression workloads, not real-malware accuracy
datasetLimits: Held-out seeds change paths, event sizes and timing jitter on teaching scenario templates; templates themselves are shared with development. This does not measure unseen ransomware-family generalization.
falseAlertTimeLimit: Only per-run false-alert fractions are reported. Trace durations are short and are not real wall-clock monitoring hours; no false-alert-per-hour extrapolation is made.
sizeMetricLimit: Observed sizes sum maximum file size per distinct path, not exact byte ranges overwritten or permanent loss.
containmentLimit: No containment measurements here: this is pure event replay. Desktop lab separately reports cooperative worker pause and snapshot restoration.
